evidence: Applied check-probe-not-in-seed.py by hand (deterministic-checks.md:56). Collected every probe the judge creates across all five judge.toml files: 44 distinct JUDGE-* tokens (CS1, W0, L1, M1, M2, WL0, WL1, R0-R3, R1B, RX, X0, X1, E1, F1, F2, P1-P3, U1-U3, D1, D2, O, LB, LG, LA, LR, LE, LV, T0, T1, S0-S2, H0-H3, H1C, G1) plus their full phrases ('Version one JUDGE-E1', 'Hijack', 'Too late', 'Half typed', 'Persist gone', 'Order A/B/C', 'Unread gone', '@Dev ...', the safe_formatting payload with onerror/alert/example.org, etc.). grep over task/environment (seed + notes), task/solution (server.js, app.js, index.html, seed copy, solve.sh) and task/instruction.md returned zero hits for any of them. server.js:93-126 imports only seed_data.json once (no hardcoded demo messages), so the reference's initial state equals the seed. Seed has no '@' mentions, so Dev's mention list (wall_mentions_and_links) starts empty. Mutated non-text state is also not pre-satisfied: persistence sets M-12 to 30 days (seed M-12 timer_days null, seed_data.json:130) and walls Sian from M-11 (seed M-11 walled [], :43); timer_changes changes M-13 30->7 (seed 30, :163) with a visible-before positive control; hold_scope_and_release holds new JUDGE-H1 and releases seeded held K-17 'Insurer letter acknowledged.' (hold true, :67-70) which must be visible before release to be operated on; wall_added_live walls Sian from M-13 (seed walled []); edits create a new edited message (JUDGE-S0/E1) rather than reusing seeded K-2/K-13 versions; Gwen's unread>=2 is driven by fresh JUDGE-U posts against seed read_up_to M-13=K-9 (latest). Absence checks on seeded text (Boundary note, original lease scan, Probate/2,400, notice recieved, heads of terms, Fenwick) are each paired with a positive control (K-11 one second younger shown, Harriet's surviving reply, probate visible + earlier version listed, 'notice received and filed' found, Sian's JUDGE-W0 control), so a dead app cannot pass them by default. Search-substring collisions checked: searched probes (JUDGE-W0, JUDGE-X0/X1, JUDGE-D1, JUDGE-O, JUDGE-F1, Persist gone, Temp JUDGE-P2) are not substrings of any seed text or other probe that would be present when searched. Broken-app attempt: an app that re-imports the seed or fakes success cannot pre-hold any JUDGE value since none exists in seed/reference; a conforming alternative is not failed by a probe colliding with seed text. Hashes: frozen seed f69616e2... and index.html 6a49714f... match raw-evidence-index.json. Minor observation (not a defect for this row): reference index.html:60-61 has static '7 days'/'30 days' option text, but the timer_changes '7 days' check is backed by the probate deletion and reload checks, and a candidate's own markup is not the reference. State accumulation between criteria (e.g. persistence relying on earlier deletions) is row 37's concern.
